title: DCP Control Snapshot (Envelope Only)
description: SYNTHESIS_INVENTED / PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT. Envelope + authority-metadata wrapper only. Per-surface projection fields are DEFERRED pending DCP_PROJECT_RESOURCE_MAP + canonical-root reconciliation. schema_version .v0 = unstable, not authority.

schema_version.description: .v0 suffix per K-27; unstable version marker, not an authority claim.

provenance.description: Contract-level provenance per REV1 §6.0 meta-contract. SYNTHESIS_INVENTED: envelope shape invented in GPT-5.5 REV1 synthesis; not derived from a repo artifact.

validation.description: Validation status per REV1 §6.0. PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT: shape not cross-checked against repo artifact; enforcement not verified.

snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for this control snapshot.

created_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of snapshot creation.

source_pack_refs.description: References to source task packets or evidence packs contributing to this snapshot.

authority_order_ref.description: Reference to the authority-order document governing this snapshot.

surfaces.description: Per-surface projection fields are DEFERRED. Only status and note are locked in .v0.

status.description: PROVISIONAL: per-surface fields not locked in .v0.

note.description: Explanation of why per-surface fields are deferred.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance tags for all fields in this contract instance. Keys are field names; values are provenance tags.
